title: Dwellio
description: An Airbnb-inspired platform for listing, discovering, and booking unique places to stay, built with a distinct design and integrated booking and payment experiences.

title: Yapp
description: A real-time chat app for instant conversations and file sharing, featuring Firebase authentication, live messaging, and Cloudinary-powered image hosting.

title: MoviePitch
description: Turn a one-line idea into a full movie pitch — title, synopsis, cast, and an AI-generated poster — powered by Google Gemini and Cloudflare Workers AI.

title: GhibliGaze
description: A single-page tribute to Studio Ghibli's films, bringing together movie info, trailers, a gallery, and news in one browsing experience for fans to explore.

title: Dictionary
description: A fast, minimal dictionary app for looking up definitions, synonyms, antonyms, and usage examples — built for quick vocabulary lookups without the clutter.
